The pure class interface. 
public abstract class Config
  extends Term
The abstract class of configurations associated with concrete languages.

Objects of this class give generic information about a concrete language, to be used by the parser and unparser.

Author:
Wolfgang Grieskamp (wg@cs.tu-berlin.de)
Version: $Id: Config.pizza,v 1.4 1998/12/08 09:30:09 wg Exp $

Config
public Config();

diag
protected transient Diag diag;
Accumulated diagnostics of directive evaluation. Subclasses may add diagnostics to this field.

copy
public Config copy();
Make a copy of this configuration.

enter

public abstract void enter(Text[] texts);
Enter and evaluate directives found in given array of text. The configuration will be enriched if directives are found which have effect for the concrete language.

getAndClearDiag

public Diag getAndClearDiag();
Get and clear accumulated diagnostics produced by directive evaluation.

isLeftOffside

public boolean isLeftOffside(Lexem lexem);
Tell wether one ore more line separators (Lexem.Linesep) at the left of this lexem are `offside'. An offside line separator is ignored by the parser. (Resp. can be inserted as layout by the unparser).

isRightOffside

public boolean isRightOffside(Lexem lexem);
Tell wether one ore more line separators (Lexem.Linesep) at the right of this lexem are `offside'. An offside line separator is ignored by the parser. (Resp. can be inserted as layout by the unparser).

needSpaceBetween

public boolean needSpaceBetween(Text left,
                                Text right);
Return wether there have to be spaces put between left and right lexems.

Return representation of the given lexem in the concrete language.
